description: This file contains React functional components that display various status indicators for verification cards (VC), execution, and chain progress in a web UI. It includes multiple UI components, utility functions, and imports external icons and types.

methods.name: VCStatusIndicator
methods.description: Displays verification status with icons, labels, and optional details or clickability.

methods.name: ExecutionVCStatus
methods.description: Displays the status of a verification credential associated with an execution, including options to view or download the VC.

methods.name: VCChainStatus
methods.description: Displays progress status of a verification chain with visual progress indicator and status labels.
